title: Un continente antes de Europa
goal: Read a continent-wide picture of the Americas before 1492, and talk about who lived there and what came before the Maya, Mexica and Inca.

items: Explain why nobody knows exactly how many people lived in the Americas before 1492.
Describe two influential cultures that came before the Maya, Mexica and Inca.
Name one enduring archaeological mystery from the reading.
Explain where maize and the potato were each domesticated.
Use formal connectors like 'a lo largo de' and 'mientras que'.
I can explain why nobody knows exactly how many people lived in the Americas before 1492.
I can describe two influential cultures that came before the Maya, Mexica and Inca.
I can name one enduring archaeological mystery from the reading.
I can explain where maize and the potato were each domesticated.
I can use formal connectors like 'a lo largo de' and 'mientras que'.
